title: WM69007: Planning And Design Of Water Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Design of water harvesting system; Efficiency of water supply system; Urban
water resources: availability, improvement and efficient management; Optimal
water allocation design; Design of quality control of water supply system
(quality issues and measures); Climate change adoption measures for city water
supply system; Water and development issues; Economic feasibility of water
supply programs/projects; Clean water accessibility - case study; and
Flood/drought damage - case study.
